name: Dumbbell Pullover
cues: Lie on a flat bench holding one dumbbell over your chest with both hands
Keep a slight, fixed bend in your elbows
Lower the dumbbell in an arc behind your head until your arms reach your ears
Pull it back over your chest along the same arc
